# omegacs.us - Omega Creative Systems

> Joseph Landry is a systems administrator who uses AI to build tools, agent fleets and home-lab projects. He writes the spec, AI writes most of the code, and he tests it on real data. OmegaCS stands for Omega Creative Systems, the name he publishes his own work under. This file summarizes the public site for AI readers.

## How he works
- Simple beats clever. Low variance. Search before you build.
- Nudge, don't block. Same input, same output. Read-only by default.
- Extra accuracy where mistakes are expensive. Built so another person or AI can maintain it.
- Process: find the friction, write the spec, AI builds and he reviews, prove it on real data with a go/no-go test, ship small and keep patching.

## What he builds at work (described generically)
- AI skills that turn a process into a repeatable document tool (scopes, plans, BOMs, status reports).
- Read-only-by-default MCP connectors for ticketing and documentation systems, auto-updating via CI releases.
- A fleet of single-purpose agent bots with an orchestrator, a desired-state baseline, and an approval list.
- A firewall config migration mapper, verified three ways, used in production by other techs.

## Personal projects
- An unnamed game: his own Godot 4 / C# life sim + action RPG. 20 system specs, ~1,000 C# files, ~120k lines, 200+ test files. NPCs physically do the work; the player is an NPC with a different input. Validated with 100+ day headless runs.
- vexp: found and reported four bugs in the vexp AI context engine over two days and four releases (v2.0.27-2.0.30), each with repro packages and debug traces: zero C# search results (developer adopted his suggested BM25-promotion fallback; fixed next release; developer called it "one of the most useful bug reports we've received"), inconsistent fix across classes (side-by-side trace comparison), LSP call edges collected but never queried due to FQN format mismatch, and blast-radius view showing outbound not inbound calls. Method: verify the data layer directly, isolate the failing layer, compare passing vs failing cases, retest every release.
- Rewire: OpenWrt package suite for retired Meraki MX64 firewalls; OPNsense plugin port in progress.
- Home network on a Sophos XGS 116 running OPNsense.
- Game preservation: offline rebuilds of games.
- MX64 to OpenWrt flash guide.

## Background
Entra ID, Intune, Windows 365, Active Directory, Meraki, firewall migrations, SharePoint and NAS migrations, plain-language technical writing.
